description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) DEFT PARRY (Vigilator Squad, passive): melee attacks that target the unit have -1 to hit. Fixture cus11e_c7_enemy_fight (P1 Orks' Fight phase; the Boyz charged and are engaged with the Vigilators of P2). After the pile-ins, a real click selects the Boyz to fight; attacks are assigned and resolved through the attack dialog and the resolution dock. The Boyz' melee hit roll carries the Deft Parry -1 (modifier ledger) and the fight dice log names it. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP.
